subject: Discovery call recap & proposed demo times

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>

Cc: Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-03-15T15:02:00-07:00
Subject: Discovery call recap & proposed demo times

Hi Tom —

Thanks again for taking the time today. Quick recap from our discovery: Acme is focused on lowering per-request cost for high-concurrency inference, needs predictable latency under 200ms p95 for customer-facing flows, and has strict data residency and audit requirements. You mentioned a 6–9 month timeline for a pilot and a likely SLA requirement for Dedicated capacity.

Next steps I propose:
- 45-minute technical deep dive + demo focused on latency profiles and routing/fallover (we'll demo a live workload and discuss batching/quantization tradeoffs)
- Invite your Eng + SRE folks so we can go into infra details and performance numbers

Please pick one of these windows (PT):
- Wed Mar 18 — 10:00–10:45am PT
- Thu Mar 19 — 9:00–9:45am PT
- Thu Mar 19 — 2:00–2:45pm PT

If none of these work, send a couple times that do and I will align calendars. Also, could you confirm who from your team will attend and any specific topics (e.g., KV cache, autoscaling policies, VPC setup)?

Once we lock a time I’ll send a calendar invite with a Zoom link and a short agenda + one-pager.

Thanks — looking forward to the next step.

Best,
Marissa Cole
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
marissa_cole@redwood.ai
(415) 555-0142
